description:
Ashley thought she and her husband were in love, but he abused her and she died giving birth to a child. Before she could take revenge on him, she opened her eyes and found herself in a pre-marriage phase with him. She felt like she was going to live that hellish life again, so she looked for a replacement husband for her. Ashley went straight to visit Duke Esperad Camedici, who was rumored to have been afflicted by a curse after his fiancée died under mysterious circumstances. 

 *"I'm Ashley, I would like to ask Your Grace to marry me."
"Does what you said mean that you wish to die now?"
"Do you think the misfortune that has befallen me is a joke?"*

Ashley knows that he will become emperor, so she tries to win his heart. Moreover, she has finally replaced her husband, and yet he is still arguing with her. Will Ashley be able to take revenge across time and space and succeed in replacing her husband? 

(Source: KakaoPage)
